title: Evidence: Return Not Received
submitted_text:
As of January 23, the return tracking (9400111899223100567890) shows only "Shipping label created, USPS awaiting item" from January 18. Five days with no scan activity.

I called USPS customer service on January 22. The representative confirmed that the tracking shows only a label was created and there is no record of the package being scanned into the USPS system at any facility. They said this typically means the package was never handed to USPS.

I cannot accept a refund without receiving the item back. This is a $649.99 office chair. If I refund before receiving the return, I lose both the item and the money. Platform policy (§1.3) states refunds are issued for qualifying conditions — a return that hasn't shipped doesn't qualify.
